name: Paradisus Playa del Carmen, La Perla
positioning: The La Perla side of the all-inclusive Paradisus Playa del Carmen resort (officially Paradisus Playa del Carmen - Riviera Maya), set in a mangrove forest with direct beach access, whirlpool-terrace suites and its own bars and restaurants
best_for: Travelers who want an all-inclusive beach stay in a suite with a whirlpool tub on the terrace
Guests who enjoy a sake-and-cocktail bar, Latin fusion dining and spa treatments made with local ingredients

facts.text: Paradisus Playa del Carmen is an all-inclusive resort.
The resort has direct access to the beach.
Beaches, coral reefs, cenote pools and Mayan ruins are found in nearby Playa del Carmen.
The Junior Suite Nature View has tropical-style furniture and a private terrace with garden views.
The Suite Nature View is a one-bedroom suite with a whirlpool tub on a garden-view terrace.
The fitness center offers Pilates, yoga, spinning, wellness and massage classes.
The resort hosts weddings through Romance by Paradisus.
The hotel describes itself as LGBTQ+ friendly.
Lemon Fish, located at Paradisus La Perla, serves Latin fusion cuisine with fresh ceviches.
Fahrenheit is a pool bar at Paradisus La Perla that serves drinks and grilled snacks.

highlights.text: The resort is located in a mangrove forest very near large beaches with fine, white sand.
The Master Suite Nature View has a spacious living room, a dining area and a whirlpool bathtub on a garden-view terrace.
The YHI Spa offers body and facial treatments made with Mexican honey, essential oils and local ingredients.
Toji, located at Paradisus La Perla, is a Japanese-style bar for sake and creative mixology.
The resort offers a personalized butler service.

considerations.text: With the Roulette Room, assignment to either Paradisus Playa del Carmen or Paradisus La Perla depends on availability and cannot be guaranteed.
The yoga class at a Mayan cenote in the jungle is an offsite experience.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the resort's luxury positioning.
